ground_truth.title: Faculty Research & Lab Equipment Allocation Committee
ground_truth.reference_transcript: Dean Vance: Welcome colleagues to the quarterly research resource committee. Professor Higgins, what is our standing on high-performance compute allocations? Professor Higgins: Our shared GPU cluster is running at 94% utilization, causing bottleneck delays for student dissertation research. I propose requisitioning four additional dedicated server nodes. I will compile the detailed vendor cost breakdown and RFP specifications by November 9th. Dean Vance: Very reasonable. Dr. Thorne, how is the laboratory safety compliance audit proceeding? Dr. Thorne: The inspection discovered two chemical storage ventilation units requiring certified recalibration. I will schedule the certified technicians and submit the compliance sign-off report by November 12th. Dean Vance: Thank you. Let us record our official decisions: First, we approve the emergency capital expenditure budget of forty-five thousand dollars for GPU cluster expansion. Do all members consent? Professor Higgins: Yes, consented. Dr. Thorne: Consented. Dean Vance: Second, we decide that all laboratory access badges will be temporarily suspended if safety audits are not completed within thirty days of notice.
